title: papyrus stories note fails for a signed-in user: not authorized for createMessage
description: 2026-11-03, Machines on Machines, papyrus 5.81, signed in through the CLI: stories note fails with: Not Authorized to access createMessage on type Mutation. Exit code 2. Stories create, assign-research and the stage move all worked in the same session, so the reporting trail is the piece an agent cannot write. The command prints a 'write' line even though nothing was saved. Fails with and without PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID. docs/story-reporting.md presents this as the way to record everything said during reporting. Cause not yet traced.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Possible lead, not confirmed: AGENTS.md:243 says Messages come only from people (epic PPY-781d26), and PPY-59edce covers agent chat and console notes without machine Messages. If the refusal of createMessage is deliberate, then docs/story-reporting.md is wrong to tell agents to use stories note, and agents need another place to record reporting. Check that first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed by #1151; the refused call came from the old CLI. Tested live on 5.85.0, signed in: stories note wrote and shows in stories show.
